body:
Hi team,

Quick thing I noticed on the Grizzly Air site. It is a single page, and every 'Learn More' link under your six services just loops back to that same page. There are no reviews anywhere, no booking option, and the Areas We Serve section does not name one single city, so a Phoenix homeowner has no way to tell if you even cover them.

For an HVAC company in this heat, that one page is doing far less than it should.

This is the kind of site I build. I worked on Parker and Sons here in Phoenix (parkerandsons.com), a strong local name with services and contact details laid out properly. Emergency HVAC Squad (emergencyhvacsquad.com) is another of mine, set up so a hot and stressed homeowner can reach help in a couple of taps.

So I went ahead and redesigned your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Every service gets its own real section, the Areas We Serve part actually says where you work, your phone number sits one tap away at the top, and there is room up front for the reviews and offers that are missing now.

If you like the direction, I can build it out on your real domain with full service pages behind it. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Thanks for your time,
Hassan
name: Grizzly Air LLC
subject: ❄️ Your Learn More links all lead back home
